speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms; to pinpoint the cause, please tell me if you have noticed any joint pain, fatigue, or a rash specifically on your knuckles or elbows.

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: THANK YOU for that information. The work on your rice farm and with livestock is very relevant; do you notice any skin lesions, scaling, or discoloration on your hands, feet, or nails, and have you noticed any eye symptoms like redness or irritation? REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, ANA, RF. REQUEST IMAGES: Full_body_dermatologic_exam.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work and full-body exam were normal, which is helpful. Given your work on a rice farm and the tingling in your palms, do you experience burning pain, redness, or swelling in your hands or feet, and do you have any difficulty seeing at night or dark spots in your vision?

REQUEST TEST: Fasting Plasma Glucose, HbA1c, Urinalysis.
REQUEST IMAGES: Foot_exam, Retinal_exam.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work, glucose, and eye exams were normal, which helps rule out diabetes and some systemic autoimmune conditions. Given your history on a rice farm and livestock, I need to know if your rash has a specific pattern, such as ring-shaped lesions or blisters on your hands and feet, and if you have any respiratory issues like chronic cough or shortness of breath.

REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay, Spirometry.
REQUEST IMAGES: Hand_close_up, Foot_close_up.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the normal chest X-ray and spirometry results, and your specific history working on a rice farm and with livestock, I must determine if your symptoms are due to a parasitic infection like Chagas disease or a toxic exposure from the environment. Do you have any swelling in your eyelids, a history of a bug bite in the past, or difficulty swallowing? REQUEST TEST: Serology for Trypanosoma cruzi, Electrolytes, TSH. REQUEST IMAGES: Palmar_plantar_exam.
